implementation.finding: A synchronous working-status observer could close the scheduler before the next operation, but the scheduler still invoked it.
implementation.repair: Register active work first and recheck stop/gate after observer publication; preserve the directed reproduction and actual guard-removal control.
implementation.evidence: initial-observer-failure.log; control-after-close.json; current driver unit case

implementation.finding: A successful pass announced idle while additional captured work remained.
implementation.repair: Keep working status through backlog yields and announce idle only after an empty pass. Expose starting before the initial storage check; freeze runtime status from construction.
implementation.evidence: initial-idle-failure.log; native rapid-edit/capture-drain check; strengthened final unit assertion

harness.finding: The installed Playwright waitForFunction polls the truthiness of an async predicate Promise, and can complete with false. This caused new drain waits to return prematurely.
harness.repair: Use an explicit bounded Node loop awaiting page.evaluate results; apply it to the new drain and native lock-pending checks. Retain a live reproduction contrasting the installed wait with the corrected wait.
harness.scope: Older unrelated harness async-predicate usage was not comprehensively audited in this phase.

timeout.finding: The initial eight-history native run exceeded its 110-second test deadline.
timeout.response: Added history progress output, per-history browser cleanup and explicit awaited completion checks. A focused eight-history run completed in about 106 seconds. Final test deadline is 180 seconds with a 300-second runner-stage watchdog; timeout is not treated as a minimized protocol counterexample.

scheduler.oracle: Independent clock and deferred invocation ledger: one active pass, at most one timer, retry floor, no post-close work, drain completion.

native.oracle: Retained wire-by-position compared at every retry with actual SQLite rows; exact capture/envelope/acceptance coverage, invocation counts and reopened writing checked.

generated.result: No additional production counterexample was demonstrated by the final generated histories.

controls: Removing scheduler concurrency guards invokes two owner passes concurrently.
Removing the post-observer stop check invokes an owner pass after close.
Removing the final dispatch gate permits HTTP submission after a connectivity change at that boundary.
limits: Private first epoch/one creating credential; no inbound content application, enrollment, UI or personal provisioning.
Driver runtime status and retry timing are not durable acceptance authority.
Full retained-ledger scans/backlog performance, pruning and whole-state restore/rollback remain open.
Final focused campaigns and 13 repository gates are individually executed; no whole pnpm check run is claimed.
